one_liner: Copper offers a REST API with API Key and OAuth2.0 authentication for CRM data access.
gating_notes: API access is available on trial, professional, and business plans. OAuth2.0 registration requires contacting partners@copper.com to obtain client credentials.
oauth_details: OAuth2.0 uses the Authorization Code Grant flow. Registration requires contacting partners@copper.com to receive client_id and client_secret.

auth_methods.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.

primary_auth.quote: API Keys are suitable for individual users, while OAuth2.0 is the preferred approach for partner integrations.

credential_access.quote: Available on our trial, professional and business plan

api_type.quote: The API provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to use Copper entities.
